column1: # CI screen pass (scripts/verify/ci-screens.sh): slug, demo query, hash route. One row per capture slug, reached on ?demo
# (demo data only, no crewd, no model). Every slug here is a mocks.tsv slug but jobs (the Stack frame's Jobs place has no design render yet); a slug not listed reaches no ?demo route:
#   where, cloud-pick, cloud-key, computer   the cloud and first-run pages (CREWHOUSE_CLOUD build, public shell)
#   call-idle, call-listening, call-speaking, call-voice   the voice call opens by a tap on the microphone, no URL state
#   handoff-ipad   an iPad-only width, outside 390 and 1440
#   chief-attach, unlock-card   no demo variant puts the attachment or the locked-file card in Chief's thread
#   model-pick   #/settings/ai/chatgpt renders a blank page on ?demo (a product defect, not a capture one): left out until fixed
